description: Labeled content for deterministic compliance-accuracy measurement. Every case is scored with brand_check_compliance against a copy of test/fixtures/brand-complete, whose governed values are: colors #2a4494 (primary), #e8523f (secondary), #f5a623 (accent); typography Inter; hard visual anti-pattern 'No drop shadows'. That fixture has no messaging layer, so never-say vocabulary rules are not exercised here (see eval/README.md). Each case was verified to reproduce its expected verdict before being committed.

cases.reason: Uses only governed palette colors (#2a4494, #e8523f) plus neutral white, and the brand font Inter.
Inline styles stay on-palette (primary + accent + neutrals) with the brand font.

cases.content: Quarterly report
cases.reason: rgb(42, 68, 148) normalizes to the governed primary #2a4494; white is neutral.
border-radius is not a governed anti-pattern for this brand (only drop shadows are), so on-palette content with rounded corners passes.

cases.content: Fixture Brand builds structured, clear tools for modern teams. Start a project in minutes and keep every surface consistent.
cases.reason: Plain text has no visual surface to violate, and this brand governs no vocabulary rules; the tool checks zero rules and passes. Documents the tool's text-input behavior.
#7b2ff7 (purple) is not in the governed palette and is not a whitelisted neutral — CRT-COLOR fails.
Shorthand #f00 normalizes to #ff0000, which is off-palette — CRT-COLOR fails.

cases.content: Success
cases.reason: rgb(0, 128, 0) normalizes to #008000, an off-palette green — CRT-COLOR fails.
Playfair Display is not a governed brand font (and not a generic system font) — CRT-FONT fails.
box-shadow violates the hard anti-pattern 'No drop shadows' even though colors and font are on-brand (rgba black normalizes to neutral #000000).
text-shadow also violates the hard 'No drop shadows' anti-pattern.

cases.content: Big promo
cases.reason: Off-palette #ff0066, non-brand font Comic Sans MS, and a drop shadow — all three critical checks fail.
